before.title: Modelle vergleichen: Ziehen ohne vs. mit Zurücklegen
before.titleEn: Compare models: without vs. with replacement

before.descriptionEn: The learner can justify when the "with replacement" model is a good approximation for "without replacement" and compare both models using concrete examples (e.g., a large urn).
